sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.
2.

The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the FIR dated 11.02.204 registered as Case Crime No.105 of 2024 under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Secxtion 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Robertsganj, District-Sonbhadra.

Piyush Kumar Bansal And 7 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10261404/

entities.text: Piyush Kumar Bansal And 7 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the basis of instructions, learned counsel for the petitioners states that the present matter relates to matrimonial dispute and both the parties have amicably settled the matter.
3. Learned A.G.A. submits that during investigation no complicity of the petitioners was found in the alleged offence, hence, final report was prepared and filed before the concerned court.

As such the writ petition has rendered itself as infructuous as the cause for filing the writ petition no more survives and the same is liable to be dismissed.
4.
Considering the categorical statement of learned A.G.A., we are not inclined to proceed further in the matter.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is consigned to record.
